sections.title: Work and education: meaning and form
body: Goal: Describe skills and experience, understand a course or job notice and request additional information.
Core vocabulary: en behörighet, arbetslivserfarenhet, deltid. Key phrases: Jag har erfarenhet av kundservice. · Jag kan arbeta självständigt och i team. · När börjar kursen och vilka krav gäller?

Use kan for ability, har erfarenhet av + noun or -ing form for experience, and har arbetat som + occupation for previous or currently relevant experience. Formal notices often compress information, so expand key requirements into complete questions before responding.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

body: Register model: “Jag skriver för att anmäla mitt intresse för tjänsten.” is a formal-neutral application way to express “I am writing to express my interest in the position.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What must participants be able to do? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Which item is an advantage but not a requirement? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Introduce yourself for a course or job inquiry. Mention two skills, one relevant experience and ask two precise questions. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a 120-word expression of interest for an original part-time role. Connect your experience to the listed tasks and state your availability. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The role changes from customer service to a training course; adapt your evidence and questions rather than reusing the application unchanged.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
